How It Works

From idea to live in 4 steps

01

Share your idea

Message on WhatsApp with your business name, what you sell, and any site you like the look of.

02

Design & motion

We design your pages with animation and a 3D feel — built mobile-first, so it shines on phones.

03

Review on your phone

You get a private preview link. Open it on your phone, check everything, ask for changes.

04

Launch + handover

After payment, your site goes live 24/7 and the files or account access are handed over to you.

Questions

Before you order

Do I need to buy a domain?

No. Your site can go live on a free link that stays online 24/7. If you later want your own .com domain, we can connect it — the domain would be bought in your own name.

How do customers order from me?

Message on WhatsApp first. You see a preview of your site on a private link, and only after payment is the site handed over — as files, or deployed to your own account so you fully own it.

Will it work well on phones?

Yes — every site is designed mobile-first and tested at phone size. Animations use lightweight code, so pages stay fast on mobile Chrome.

How long does it take?

It depends on the package and how fast you send your content (name, photos, prices). The timeline is confirmed on WhatsApp before work starts.

Can I update the site later?

Yes. Small text and photo changes can be done anytime — just message on WhatsApp and we will update and re-publish your site.

This is how we show a customer their future store: the product is not a flat photo — it floats under the spotlight, spins a full 360°, zooms into the fabric, changes design layers and changes worlds. Try everything below — it is all live.

Why It Sells

Not a photo. A product.

A flat photo is easy to scroll past. A product customers can spin, zoom and restyle feels real — and real products get orders.
